ov: شابة واعدة (الإنجليزية: Promising Young Woman) هو فيلم كوميديا سوداء أمريكي انتج عام 2020 كتبه وأخرجته وشاركت في إنتاجه إميرالد فينيل في أول ظهور لها في فيلم روائي طويل. من بطولة كاري موليجان، بو بورنهام عُرض الفيلم لأول مرة في مهرجان صاندانس السينمائي في 25 يناير 2020.
plotEn:
Thirty-year-old medical school drop-out Cassandra "Cassie" Thomas lives with her parents and works in a coffee shop. Cassie abandoned her studies to take care of her best friend, Nina Fisher, who, when drunk one night, was raped by their classmate Al Monroe while others watched and did nothing to help her. Nina dropped out of medical school and later committed suicide.
Wracked with guilt for not having been there to protect Nina the night of the rape, Cassie dedicates herself to punishing men who take advantage of drunk women. At night, she visits bars pretending to be intoxicated, entrapping men into taking her home in the hope of having sex with her before she reveals she is sober and confronts them menacingly.
Despite some hesitation, Cassie starts dating Ryan Cooper, a former classmate who is now a pediatric surgeon, although she insists on taking it slow. She is beginning to feel happy again when Ryan mentions that Al is soon to be married and her anger resurfaces; she begins enacting a series of revenge plans and also begins picking up strange men once again. Ryan breaks up with her when he sees her exiting a bar with a man she has tricked into thinking she is drunk.
Cassie tracks down Madison McPhee, a former friend who dismissed Nina's story and blamed Nina for what happened to her; she invites Madison to lunch, gets her drunk, and arranges for a man to take her to a hotel room.
